verdict.rationale: Circle Mint lets qualified businesses convert USD to/from USDC (circle-docs-13), CPN supports fiat payouts settled in USDC (circle-docs-12), and Gateway/CCTP enable rebalancing USDC across chains (circle-docs-31, circle-docs-4/16). However the evidence pack lacks concrete end-to-end API/dashboard walkthroughs for fiat↔stablecoin internal transfers specifically for a treasury/finance-lead use case. missing for 10: dedicated Circle Mint API/dashboard documentation showing fiat deposit/withdrawal flows, explicit internal-transfer/rebalancing tutorial, and independent corroboration of the workflow.
